BDI.note: The Senate president says AI regulation is inevitable; no rule, draft or authority on AI harms is stated.
No government body's use of AI is stated.
Only a call for preliminary AI regulation; no draft or rule on AI is stated.
Only an invitation to investors for AI in farming, health and other sectors; no tool in service or under way.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Burundi.

facts.fact: The Senate president told the IPU Assembly on 14 October 2024 that Burundi's parliament has already voted a law repressing cybercrime, though it has not reached the expected level.
